title: Decentralized Multitask Learning over Learned Task Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates decentralized multitask learning over networks when the underlying task relationships are unknown. While existing graph-regularized multitask frameworks typically assume a known structure, practical settings often require learning inter-task dependencies directly from distributed data. We propose a decentralized two-phase strategy that first estimates a generalized graph Laplacian from noisy non-cooperative stochastic gradient iterates, and subsequently exploits the learned graph to enable cooperative multitask diffusion learning. This framework is motivated by a Gaussian Markov random field prior, which gives rise to a decentralized maximum likelihood estimator for the graph Laplacian. translated_title: 基于学习任务图的去中心化多任务学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了当底层任务关系未知时，网络上的去中心化多任务学习问题。现有的图正则化多任务框架通常假设已知结构，但实际场景往往需要直接从分布式数据中学习任务间依赖关系。我们提出了一种去中心化的两阶段策略：首先从噪声非协作随机梯度迭代中估计广义图拉普拉斯算子，随后利用学习到的图来实现协作多任务扩散学习。该框架由高斯马尔可夫随机场先验驱动，由此产生了图拉普拉斯算子的去中心化最大似然估计器。分析量化了拉普拉斯估计误差及其对多任务扩散递归稳态性能的传播影响，并引入了一个拓扑敏感性指标来捕捉网络异质性的效应。
tldr: 本文提出了一种去中心化两阶段方法，在任务关系未知时通过估计广义图拉普拉斯算子并利用其实现协作多任务扩散学习，同时量化了估计误差和网络异质性的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decentralized two-phase approach that estimates a generalized graph Laplacian from noisy gradients and leverages it for cooperative multitask diffusion learning when task relationships are unknown, quantifying estimation error and network heterogeneity effects.
